primitives.name: Button
primitives.description: Baseline command primitive with six variants, sm/md/lg/icon sizes, and normal/loading/disabled states.

values.name: Primary
values.description: The one main action in a region.

values.name: Secondary
values.description: A supporting action beside the primary one.

values.name: Outline
values.description: A bordered action that stays quiet on busy surfaces.

values.name: Ghost
values.description: A borderless action for toolbars and dense rows.

values.name: Destructive
values.description: An action that deletes or cannot be undone.

values.name: Link
values.description: An action that reads as inline text.

values.name: Small
values.description: Dense rows, toolbars, and inline actions.

values.name: Large
values.description: Prominent calls to action and touch-first layouts.

values.name: Icon
values.description: A square button holding only an icon.

values.name: Loading
values.description: Its command is running; the label gives way to a loading mark.

values.name: Disabled
values.description: It cannot be pressed right now.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: The command in a word or two.

slots.name: Icon
slots.description: An optional glyph before the label.

primitives.accessibility: A native keyboard-reachable button whose visible label supplies its accessible name; the icon size keeps the label as visually hidden text.
notes: Apps should replace token values and variant naming only when their design system requires it; do not recreate one-off buttons per screen.
implementationHints: Map variants to the target app's button API and preserve loading and disabled behavior.
Icon: Keep a text label for the accessible name when rendering icon-only.
Hover: Apply on pointer hover only; touch platforms skip it.
Focus: Show on keyboard focus (focus-visible), not on pointer press.
Loading: Expose busy state to accessibility APIs.
Disabled: Prevent interaction and expose disabled state.

primitives.name: Input
primitives.description: Text input primitive with visual variants and validation states.

values.name: Default
values.description: A bordered field on a plain surface.

values.name: Filled
values.description: A tinted field without a border.

values.name: Ghost
values.description: A borderless field that blends into its surface.

values.name: Outline
values.description: A field with a stronger border.

values.name: Underline
values.description: A field drawn as a single bottom rule.

values.name: Empty
values.description: Nothing typed yet; the placeholder shows.

values.name: Focused
values.description: Has keyboard focus and is ready for typing.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: Names the field above it.

slots.name: Placeholder
slots.description: A hint shown while the field is empty.

primitives.accessibility: A native text input with a programmatically associated label and a visible focus ring.
notes: Input states are a core app behavior and should not be inferred from a single rendered form.
implementationHints: Preserve empty, value, focused, invalid, and disabled states in target code.

primitives.name: Checkbox

slots.name: Label
slots.description: Names the option beside the box.

primitives.accessibility: A keyboard-reachable binary selection control whose checked and disabled states are exposed to assistive technology.
implementationHints: Expose checked and disabled states explicitly.
Focus: Show on keyboard focus (focus-visible).

primitives.name: Switch

slots.name: Label
slots.description: Names the setting beside the switch.

primitives.accessibility: A binary toggle exposing its on/off state with an associated visible label and an explicit disabled presentation.
implementationHints: Keep touch target larger than the visual thumb where needed.
Focus: Show on keyboard focus (focus-visible).

primitives.name: OTP input

values.name: Focused
values.description: The next empty cell has focus.

primitives.accessibility: A fixed-length passcode input announced as one field with a visible focus cell and caret.
implementationHints: Model cell count and focus behavior explicitly.

primitives.name: Slider

values.name: Primary
values.description: The fill uses the primary color.

values.name: Secondary
values.description: The fill uses the secondary color.

values.name: Contrast
values.description: The fill uses the foreground color for maximum contrast.

values.name: Disabled
values.description: Shows its value but cannot be dragged.

primitives.accessibility: A range control exposing its value, minimum, and maximum with a keyboard-operable thumb.
implementationHints: Keep track, fill, thumb, disabled, and contrast variants separate.

primitives.name: Surface
primitives.description: Sequential surface ladder: each nested surface, card, grouped list, or pressable row sits one level deeper than its parent.

values.name: Surface 1
values.description: The base level, directly on the page.

values.name: Surface 2
values.description: One level up: a card or panel on the base.

values.name: Surface 3
values.description: Two levels up: content inside a card.

values.name: Surface 4
values.description: Three levels up, for deeply nested content.

values.name: Surface 5
values.description: Four levels up, the deepest level.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: Names the level in the specimen.

primitives.accessibility: A non-interactive container level; nested content keeps its own semantics and reachability.
notes: Roots marked data-blueprint-surface take the level after their nearest marked ancestor; a surface state sets an explicit level for its subtree.
implementationHints: Carry the parent surface level through context so nested cards, lists, and rows render one level deeper.

primitives.name: Card

values.name: Default
values.description: A bordered card on its surface.

values.name: Flat
values.description: A card without a border or shadow.

values.name: Elevated
values.description: A card lifted off its surface with a shadow.

values.name: Status accent
values.description: A card with an accent edge that flags its status.

slots.name: Content
slots.description: The content the card groups.

primitives.accessibility: A neutral content container; interactive children remain individually reachable.
implementationHints: Use cards for repeated content items, not page sections.

primitives.name: Navigation bar

values.name: Back and right
values.description: A back action on the left and an action on the right.

values.name: Back only
values.description: Only a back action, for screens deeper in a stack.

values.name: Right only
values.description: Only a trailing action, for the root of a stack.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: The screen title, centered.

primitives.accessibility: A navigation landmark with a centered title and accessibly named slot actions.
implementationHints: Keep side slots balanced so titles remain centered.

primitives.name: Back button

values.name: Medium
values.description: The default size in a navigation bar.

values.name: Small
values.description: A compact size for sheets and dense headers.

primitives.accessibility: An icon-only button whose accessible name comes from its aria label.
implementationHints: Keep icon-only controls accessible.

primitives.name: Separator

values.name: Subtle
values.description: A faint rule between closely related items.

values.name: Strong
values.description: A heavier rule between major regions.

primitives.accessibility: A thematic break exposed as a separator to assistive technology.
implementationHints: Tie divider emphasis to surface nesting level.

primitives.name: List

values.name: Plain
values.description: Rows sit directly on the page, divided by rules.

primitives.accessibility: A list of rows exposed with list and listitem semantics.
implementationHints: Use list for grouped rows and dividers.

primitives.name: Pressable row

values.name: Standalone
values.description: A row on its own, rounded on every corner.

values.name: Group first
values.description: The first row of a group, rounded on top.

values.name: Group middle
values.description: A row between others in a group, square on every corner.

values.name: Group last
values.description: The last row of a group, rounded on the bottom.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: What the row opens or selects.

primitives.accessibility: A single keyboard-reachable row-shaped button with a text-backed accessible name.
implementationHints: Keep row-shaped press behavior separate from list grouping.

primitives.name: Row layout
primitives.description: Leading/body/trailing slot layout primitive without a surface.

values.name: Leading body trailing
values.description: Leading art, body text, and a trailing accessory.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: The main line of the body.

primitives.accessibility: A purely presentational leading/body/trailing row; only interactive slot content receives focus.
implementationHints: Use when a row owns layout but not surface or press behavior.

primitives.name: Loading mark

values.name: Primary
values.description: A spinner in the primary color on any surface.

values.name: Surface
values.description: A spinner inside a filled primary circle, for busy backgrounds.

primitives.accessibility: A polite status indicator that announces busy state without trapping focus.
notes: This generalizes the reference mark into a replaceable app-owned loader.
implementationHints: Replace geometry with the app mark if one exists; keep tone states.

primitives.name: Badge

values.name: Default
values.description: The primary fill, for the most important label.

values.name: Secondary
values.description: A quieter fill for supporting labels.

values.name: Tonal
values.description: A muted fill with an accent dot.

values.name: Accent
values.description: A bordered label with an accent dot.

values.name: Destructive
values.description: An error or a destructive status.

values.name: Outline
values.description: A border only, for neutral categories.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: The status, count, or category.

primitives.accessibility: A compact status label whose visible text supplies the meaning; tone is never color-only.
implementationHints: Keep semantic badge variants text-backed, not color-only.

primitives.name: Icon

values.name: Muted
values.description: The muted foreground color, for secondary glyphs.

values.name: Accent
values.description: The accent color, to draw the eye.

slots.name: Content
slots.description: The glyph, as an inline SVG.

primitives.accessibility: A decorative inline glyph wrapper; the host supplies any accessible naming through surrounding text.
implementationHints: Keep icon sizing and stroke width tokenized.

primitives.name: Skeleton

values.name: Line
values.description: A text-height bar standing in for a line of copy.

values.name: Block
values.description: A larger block standing in for media or a card.

primitives.accessibility: A decorative loading placeholder hidden from assistive technology while content loads.
implementationHints: Tie skeleton fill to the current surface level.

primitives.name: Alert dialog

values.name: Destructive
values.description: Confirms an action that deletes or cannot be undone.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: The question, in a few words.

slots.name: Message
slots.description: What happens if they confirm.

primitives.accessibility: A modal alert dialog named by its title, described by its message, and keeping destructive intent on the confirm action only.
implementationHints: Keep destructive intent on the action, not the whole panel.

primitives.name: Context menu

values.name: Checked
values.description: Shows an item checked as the current choice.

values.name: Destructive
values.description: Shows an item for an action that deletes or cannot be undone.

primitives.accessibility: A menu of keyboard-navigable items with separator, shortcut, checked, and destructive item roles.
implementationHints: Model item, inset item, separator, shortcut, and destructive item roles.

primitives.name: Bottom sheet
primitives.description: Sheet primitive composed from handle, navbar, body, and footer slots.

values.name: Navbar
values.description: The sheet top: close, title, and done.

values.name: Footer
values.description: The sheet bottom, holding its main action.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: The sheet title, centered in its navigation bar.

primitives.accessibility: A modal sheet region whose handle, navigation, content, and footer keep a logical source order.
implementationHints: Keep sheet navbar, content, and footer slots independently targetable.

primitives.name: Text
primitives.description: Canonical type-ramp primitive binding the typography tokens to semantic text tones.

values.name: Muted
values.description: The muted foreground color, for secondary copy.

slots.name: Text
slots.description: The copy to set.

primitives.accessibility: Readable text whose tone never relies on color alone for meaning.
notes: Use the ramp roles instead of one-off font styles; screens may still set screen-local display treatments.
implementationHints: Map variants to the app's text component roles and keep tones semantic.

primitives.name: Radio

slots.name: Label
slots.description: Names the option beside the circle.

primitives.accessibility: A keyboard-reachable single-choice control whose selected and disabled states are exposed to assistive technology.
implementationHints: Expose selected and disabled states explicitly and group radios with one name.
Focus: Show on keyboard focus (focus-visible).

primitives.name: Select
primitives.description: Single-value dropdown field primitive with placeholder, value, open, and disabled states.

values.name: Placeholder
values.description: Nothing chosen yet; the placeholder shows.

slots.name: Placeholder
slots.description: A hint shown before a value is chosen.

slots.name: Value
slots.description: The chosen value.

primitives.accessibility: A named, keyboard-reachable listbox control whose value and expanded state are exposed to assistive technology.
implementationHints: Keep the listbox in the primitive; map options from the target app's data.

primitives.name: Tabs
primitives.description: In-screen section switch primitive with a selected tab and a disabled tab.

values.name: Disabled
values.description: One tab cannot be selected right now.

slots.name: Tabs
slots.description: The tab labels, in order.

slots.name: Content
slots.description: Tab elements that replace the sample tabs, each with role tab and aria-selected.

primitives.accessibility: A tablist whose selected tab and disabled tabs are exposed to assistive technology.
implementationHints: Keep one tablist per section set; expose the selected tab to assistive technology.
Pass route tabs as default slot content using .tabs__tab elements; selection follows the named state.

primitives.name: Toast
primitives.description: Transient feedback panel primitive with semantic tones and a quiet action.

values.name: Destructive
values.description: A failed action or an error.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: The message, in one line.

slots.name: Action
slots.description: An optional follow-up, such as Undo.

primitives.accessibility: A status message announced through a live region whose tone is not conveyed by color alone.
implementationHints: Announce toasts through a live region and keep them transient.

primitives.name: Textarea
primitives.description: Multi-line text field with label, hint, and validation states.

values.name: Empty
values.description: Nothing typed yet; the placeholder shows.

values.name: Focused
values.description: Has keyboard focus and is ready for typing.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: Names the field above it.

slots.name: Placeholder
slots.description: A hint shown while the field is empty.

slots.name: Hint
slots.description: Guidance or a character count below the field.

primitives.accessibility: A labelled native textarea whose hint text describes the field.
implementationHints: Map to the target platform multi-line text field and keep the visible label as its accessible name.

primitives.name: Avatar
primitives.description: Person or entity mark with initials, fallback glyph, and presence status.

values.name: Medium
values.description: The default size in rows and headers.

values.name: Initials
values.description: Shows the initials of the name.

values.name: Fallback
values.description: No name or image; shows a generic glyph.

slots.name: Initials
slots.description: One or two letters from the name.

primitives.accessibility: An image-role mark whose accessible name is the person or entity name.
implementationHints: Map to the target avatar component; replace initials with a controlled image asset when one exists.

primitives.name: Progress
primitives.description: Labelled determinate and indeterminate progress bar.

values.name: Value
values.description: Part done, with the current value.

values.name: Indeterminate
values.description: Under way, with no known end.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: Names the task above the bar.

primitives.accessibility: A progressbar with a visible label and current value.
implementationHints: Expose progress through the platform progress API with the visible label as its name.

primitives.name: Tooltip
primitives.description: Short inverse label anchored to a control.

slots.name: Label
slots.description: The label, in a few words.

primitives.accessibility: A tooltip role describing its anchor control.
implementationHints: Show on hover and keyboard focus; never put required information only in a tooltip.

primitives.name: Inline alert
primitives.description: Persistent in-flow message with a tone, title, and message.

values.name: Success
values.description: A completed action or a good outcome.

slots.name: Title
slots.description: The point, in a few words.

slots.name: Message
slots.description: What happened and what to do next.

primitives.accessibility: A status message whose title and message are read together.
implementationHints: Use role="alert" only for urgent messages that must interrupt assistive technology.

primitives.name: Segmented control
primitives.description: Single-choice set of adjacent options for switching views or ranges.

values.name: Disabled
values.description: One option cannot be selected right now.

slots.name: Options
slots.description: The option labels, in order.

slots.name: Content
slots.description: Option elements that replace the sample options, each with role radio and aria-checked.

primitives.accessibility: A radiogroup whose options are radios named by their visible labels.
implementationHints: Map to the target segmented control; use tabs instead when options switch whole panels.
Pass options as default slot content using .segmented-control__option elements; selection follows the named state.

primitives.name: Table row
primitives.description: Data table row with primary, text, numeric, and status cells.

values.name: Hover
values.description: A pointer is over the row.

slots.name: Cells
slots.description: The cell contents, in column order.

slots.name: Content
slots.description: Cell elements that replace the sample cells, each with role cell.

primitives.accessibility: A table row of cells inside a table or grid.
implementationHints: Map to the target data table row and keep numeric columns end-aligned with tabular figures.
Pass the row cells as default slot content and set --table-row-columns on an ancestor to define the column grid.
